password.reset.email.title: Password reset
password.reset.email.body:
Hey %s,

there was a request to change your password!

If you did not make this request then please ignore this email.

Otherwise, please click this link to change your password:

%s
email.change.email.title: Email change
email.change.email.body:
Hey,

we have received a request to replace the email of one of our accounts with this email.

If you are not a Dulno customer or have not requested the replacement, please ignore this email.

However, if this is a genuine request, please click on the link below to complete the change:

%s
offer.email.title: Offer
offer.email.body:
Hey %s,

we are pleased to inform you that we have put together a customized Dulno package for you.

This package is personalized to your needs.

Click on the link below to view and accept or decline the offer.

https://dulno.com/offer/%s/

We hope we have been able to meet your requirements.
Here's to good cooperation!
ticket.answer.email.title: Answer received
ticket.answer.email.body:
Hey %s,

we would like to inform you that another reply has just been added to your ticket with the title “%s”. 

To read the answer and possibly ask further questions, please click on the link below. There you will find your ticket. 

%s

We hope we were able to answer your question to your satisfaction. 
Please let us know if you have any further questions.

Kind regards
Your Dulno Team
